claims.content: The VMU User initiates recording a voucher sales return in the Voucher Sales Return module for sold vouchers from a distributor to the MSIU sales team.
The system lists options for Distributor Name from the Distributor Master.
The system captures the Sales Man Name listed from the Sales Man Master.
The system defaults the Sales Return Date to the current system date, and the Sales Return Date must be less than or equal to the system date.
The VMU User enters return voucher details, including Batch No and Voucher No.
The system verifies that the returned voucher was sold to the particular Distributor.
The system captures the Number of vouchers Returned.
The system calculates the Sales Return Amount as Number of vouchers returned multiplied by the wholesale rate.
The system records the voucher sales return in the Database.

claims.content: To record a voucher sales return for sold vouchers being returned from a distributor to the MSIU sales team.
The distributor is planning to return sold vouchers to the MSIU sales team.
The system requires the 'Name of the distributor' to be selected from the Distributor Master during a distribution transaction.
The trigger for the 'Record a Voucher Sales Return' use case is when a distributor is planning to return vouchers back to the MSIU sales team.
The VMU User initiates recording a voucher sales return in the Voucher Sales Return module for sold vouchers from a distributor to the MSIU sales team.
The system lists options for Distributor Name from the Distributor Master.
The system captures the Sales Man Name listed from the Sales Man Master.
The system defaults the Sales Return Date to the current system date, and the Sales Return Date must be less than or equal to the system date.
The VMU User enters return voucher details, including Batch No and Voucher No.
The system verifies that the returned voucher was sold to the particular Distributor.
The system captures the Number of vouchers Returned.
The system calculates the Sales Return Amount as Number of vouchers returned multiplied by the wholesale rate.
The system records the voucher sales return in the Database.

At main-flow step 2, if the Distributor Name is not available in the system, the system provides a provision to navigate quickly to its master screen to enter new Distributor details without closing the present screen.

At main-flow step 3, if the Sales Man Name is not available in the system, the system provides a provision to navigate quickly to its master screen to enter new Salesman details without closing the present screen.
At main-flow step 6, if the returned voucher was not sold to the particular Distributor, the system does not accept those vouchers as return.
